blocks.text: The Logitech Wireless Combo MK345 is a versatile logitech keyboard and mouse combo featuring a comfortable full-size keyboard with a right-handed mouse. This keyboard and mouse wireless setup offers the reliability of a cord with the freedom of advanced 2.4 GHz wireless connectivity. The Logitech keyboard and mouse wireless combo is an ideal choice for those looking for a wireless keyboard for laptop use or a wireless keyboard and mouse for mac. The usb keyboard and mouse combo provides seamless connectivity. Whether you need a wireless keyboard logitech design for home or office use, this slim keyboard and mouse wireless set works well for various environments. The wireless keyboard and mouse feature quiet operation, making it suitable for focused work settings. On/Off switch functionality enhances battery life, making this logitech mouse and keyboard a practical and efficient choice. This computer keyboard & mouse combos set can be used for different computer systems, offering compatibility and performance. The Logitech Wireless Combo MK345 delivers reliable performance and convenience.

items.label: Dependable wireless connection
items.value: Enjoy the reliability and convenience of 2.4 GHz connectivity with your logitech wireless keyboard and mouse combo, wireless range up to 10 meters away at home, or work.

items.label: Full-Size Wireless Keyboard
items.value: Comfortable, quiet typing on a familiar keyboard layout with palm rest, spill-resistant design, and media keys. This wireless keyboard and mouse logitech has easy-access to media keys

items.label: Plug and Play
items.value: MK345 works seamlessly with Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS. Experience hassle-free setup with the logitech mk345 wireless combo and wireless keyboard mouse combo for various operating systems.

items.label: Long-lasting Battery
items.value: The MK345 combo offers a full size keyboard battery life of up to 3 years and a mouse battery life of 18 months (1); batteries included

items.label: Comfortable Right-handed Mouse
items.value: This wireless USB mouse with dongle works well for this wireless mouse and keyboard combo, featuring a contoured shape for all-day comfort and smooth, precise tracking and scrolling for easier navigation.
